# Owl v0.13.1 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [README](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Owl.Box](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Box.md): Wraps data in boxes.

- [Owl.Data](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Data.md): A set of functions for `t:IO.chardata/0` with [tags](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/`Owl.Tag`).

- [Owl.IO](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.IO.md): A set of functions for handling I/O with support for `t:Owl.Data.t/0`.
- [Owl.LiveScreen](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.LiveScreen.md): A server that handles live updates in the terminal.
- [Owl.Palette](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Palette.md): A simple color picker.

- [Owl.ProgressBar](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.ProgressBar.md): A live progress bar widget.
- [Owl.Spinner](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Spinner.md): A spinner widget.
- [Owl.System](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.System.md): Alternatives to selected `System` functions with safer logging.

- [Owl.Table](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Table.md): Draws rich, customizable tables.

- [Owl.Tag](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Tag.md): A tag struct.
- [Owl.Task](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.Task.md): Runs a task using the internal supervision tree.

- [Owl.TrueColor](https://owl.hexdocs.pm/Owl.TrueColor.md): True color escape sequences.
